jobs.description:
As a Laser Operator, you will operate advanced laser cutting machines used to cut metal sheets and tubes to specification. You will monitor the quality of the production process and ensure operations run safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

 
• Setting up and operating laser cutting machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Performing quality checks on finished components.
 
• Identifying and resolving minor machine issues.
 
• Contributing to a safe and organized workplace.

 
• You have a technical education or a strong interest in technology.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

As a Press Brake Operator, you will be responsible for accurately bending metal parts based on technical drawings. You ensure that every component meets the required quality standards.

Your tasks:

 
• Setting up and operating CNC press brake machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Checking the quality and dimensions of finished parts.
 
• Making minor adjustments where necessary.
 
• Maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

 
• You have a technical background or a strong technical affinity.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)
